During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]] as they refused to take sides in the war and attempted to remain neutral. The [[Unidentified Sarrahban species|native inhabitants]] fought back, while the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rebel cell (Sarrahban)|partisans]] attempted to evacuate the planet in the ''[[Harvest Moon]]''. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was downed during the Imperial invasion, forcing a team of Alliance agents to repair the ship and escort it past the Imperial blockade.<ref name="TRG1-115" />
